scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hm, I'm sorry if I made
a big scene when you grazed
me with that attack accidentally. It's just that I was training so
diligently and blood sugar was incredibly low and the fatigue...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
嗯，剛才你不小心擦傷了我，我反應是有點大，抱歉。
都怪練得太拼，血糖低得厲害，再加上累...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hah! Admit it,
old man! You were
just scared! Me, on
the other hand...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈！承認吧，老頭！
你就是嚇著了！
換成我嘛...

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
You little
whippersnapper!
I don't know what
you're talking about!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
你這小鬼頭！
我不知道你在說什麼！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
I recognize you
from somewhere,
I think. Reidin, do you
remember this guy?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
我覺得我好像在哪裡見過你。
雷丁，你記得這傢伙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Oh come on, we see
hundreds of Archers and
Hunters and Snipers and...
I can't remember them all.
But I guess this guy's up
to snuff. Trust me on this!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
拜託，我們見過多少弓箭手、獵人、神射手...哪記得過來。
不過，這傢伙肯定夠格，信我的！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Alright, alright.
If Reidin thinks you're
worthy, then you're probably
are. In that case, I'd like to
offer to teach you my secret
skill, ''Phantasmic Arrow.''
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
好好好，雷丁說你行，那應該就沒錯。
既然如此，我就傳授你獨門絕技：幻影箭。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wait, wait. This guy
only needs a refresher.
Yeah, I'm pretty sure you
were here to learn this
skill before. Yeah, I've
got a gut feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
等等，人家只是來溫習的。
對，我敢肯定，你以前來學過這招。
嗯，直覺告訴我的。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Damn. Only a refresher?
That means you'll learn
this free of charge. Alright...
You should be able to use the
Phantasmic Arrow skill now.
Travel safely now, you hear?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
嘖，只是溫習？
那就沒法收錢了。
好吧...現在應該能用幻影箭了。
路上小心，聽見沒？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hm? You're back?
Oh, did you bring
everything? Ah, you did.
Good! Now I shall reveal
my super secret skill...
The 1st Arpesto Form!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
嗯？回來了？
東西都帶齊了？
啊，齊了，很好！
接下來就讓你見識我的超級絕技...阿爾佩斯托第一式！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wait! Wait...
Didn't you call it
Arpesto's 3rd Form
or something at first?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
等等！等等...
你剛才不是叫它阿爾佩斯托第三式之類的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Er, yes, Arpesto's
3rd Form, that's right.
It's just there's just so
many of them, that... 
Anyway, let me teach you
the ''Emergency Arrow'' skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
呃，對，阿爾佩斯托第三式，沒錯。
招式太多，難免...總之，我來教你“緊急箭”。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Whoa, hold on!
''Emergency Arrow?!''
That's the old name you
gave that skill, right?
Didn't you change it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哇，等一下！
“緊急箭”？！
那是你以前給那個技能起的名字，對吧？
你不是改過名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
What the hell
are you talkin--
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
你到底胡說什——

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Oh, you're right.
We agreed that name
was too cheesy. What
did we call it now? Um...
''Phantasmic Arrow?''
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
哦，對，我們說好那名字太土了。
現在叫什麼來著？
嗯...“幻影箭”？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Umm....
Ummm........
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯...
嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Yeah, that was the one!
''^3131FFPhantasmic Arrow^000000'' sounds
soooo much cooler than that
other name you came up with!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
沒錯，就是那個！
“^3131FF幻影箭^000000”聽起來比你之前想的那個名字酷多了！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
You can be pretty handy
sometimes, Reidin. Now,
back to the matter at hand.
I shall teach you my awesome
skill, Phantasmic Arrow. Now...
Ready your mind and body!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
雷丁，偶爾你還挺管用。
好了，說正事。
我要傳授你我的拿手絕技，幻影箭。
現在...凝神，做好準備！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Phan-!
Ta-!
Ssssss-!
Mic-!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
Phan-!
Ta-!
Ssssss-!
Mic-!

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
ARRRRRRRROOOOOOW~!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
ARRRRRRRROOOOOOW~!

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
^333333*Pant Pant*^000000
Alright, I used a special
technique to teach you the
skill-- directly into your brain. You should be able to use it
now. Why don't give it a try?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
^333333*氣喘吁吁*^000000
好了，我用特殊手法，直接把招式灌進了你的腦子。
現在應該會用了，試試看？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Swwwwwww!*
*Bang!*^000000

[Arpesto]
^333333*Pant Pant*
*Cough Cough*
*Cough Cough*^000000

[Arpesto]
WHHHHHHHY MEEEEE?!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
為什...為什麼是我？！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ar-Arpesto, no!
...........................
Oh. Oh, come on! The arrow
just glanced you! You'll be
alright. Quit being a baby.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
阿、阿爾佩斯托，不！
...
哦，拜託！箭就擦了一下！
沒事的，別像小孩子一樣大驚小怪。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Eh, don't worry about
Arpesto. He's just being
a crazy old man. I'll take
care of him, so just make
sure you make good use
of that new skill. Take care~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
別擔心阿爾佩斯托，他這瘋老頭就這樣。
我會照顧他的，你好好運用新招就行。
保重~

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hurry up and bring
^3131FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000,
^3131FF30 Pet Foods^000000 and
^3131FF5 Harpy Feathers^000000.
Then, I can teach you
the Emergency Arrow skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
快帶來這些東西：
^3131FF詛咒紅寶石5顆^000000
^3131FF寵物飼料30份^000000
^3131FF哈比的羽毛5根^000000
帶齊了，我就教你緊急箭。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Ah, very nice.
Um, as you demonstrated
earlier, my teaching technique
was perfect. But next time, use
the skill on foes that deserve
to be beaten, alright? Good.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
嗯，很好。
剛才你也證明了，我教得無可挑剔。
不過下次要拿這招對付該打的敵人，明白嗎？
很好。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Did the master send you
to me? Hmm... You're still
pretty green from the looks
of it. Yeah, I don't think there's anything I can teach quite yet.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
是師父叫你來的？
嗯...看著還嫩了點，暫時沒什麼能教你的。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Train a little more and get
some more experience in
your job. When you become
more adept at hunting, you'll
be able to grasp what I've been
teaching Hunters and Snipers.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
再練練，多積累些職業經驗。
等狩獵本領長進了，就能領會我傳授給獵人和神射手的招式。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Has the master sent you?
Ah, you definitely have the
keen, vulture like eyes of a
true Hunter. You should be
capable of learning my secret
skill, the 3rd Arpesto Form...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
師父叫你來的？
嗯，目光銳利如禿鷲，確實是個真正的獵人。
看來足以學習我的獨門絕技，阿爾佩斯托第三式...

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
It's a handy skill that
I developed while battling
Medusas and running out
of arrows. I simply call it,
''^3131FFEmergency Arrow^000000.'' Would you
be interested in learning it?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
這招很實用，是我和米杜沙交戰、箭又用光時創出來的。
名字很簡單，就叫“^3131FF緊急箭^000000”。
想學嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please!
scripts.translation: 請教我

scripts.text: Ummm...

[Arpesto]
Great, great. Of course,
you can't resist this offer
if you recognize this skill's
value. However, I'd like to
ask for a little tuition in return for me teaching this to you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
好，好，識貨的人當然捨不得錯過。
不過，教你這招，得收一點學費。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Although I feel guilt at
asking for payment from
a fellow Hunter, creating
this skill required much
sacrifice and unimaginable
bloodshed on my part...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
向同為獵人的你收費，我是有些過意不去。
可為了創出這招，我付出了莫大的犧牲，不知流了多少血...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey! You liar!
I was there when you
accidently made up that
skill when you were bored
and just messing around
with one of the Bows!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
喂，騙子！
你明明是無聊了，隨便擺弄一把弓，誤打誤撞創出來的，我當時就在旁邊！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Please Reidin,
don't entertain unfounded
rumors. It was only after
countless battles with Eddga
that I managed to invent and
perfect Emergency Arrow.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
^333333*咳咳*^000000雷丁，別信那些沒根據的謠言。
我可是與虎王交手無數次，才創出並完善了緊急箭。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Tsk tsk*^000000 Huh.
I thought you said
you developed it while
you were fighting Medusas.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^333333*Tsk tsk*^000000哼，你剛才不是說，和米杜沙打架時創出來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
A-anyway, please bring
me the following items
as tuition in exchange for
me teaching you this skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
總、總之，要學這招，先把下面這些東西帶來，作為學費。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Please bring me
^3131FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000,
^3131FF30 Pet Foods^000000 and
^3131FF5 Harpy Feathers^000000.
Then I can teach
you this skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
請帶來：
^3131FF詛咒紅寶石5顆^000000
^3131FF寵物飼料30份^000000
^3131FF哈比的羽毛5根^000000
然後我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
30 Pet Foods?
What the heck do
you need all that for?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
30份寵物飼料？
你要那麼多幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
I...
I'm going to
use it to feed
my pet Falcon.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
我...我要拿來餵我的寵物獵鷹。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
...
......
.........
......Riiiight.

[Arpesto]
Alright, it's your
decision. However, I'm
sure that you may have
great need of my skill
sooner or later, so return
to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
行，你自己決定。
不過，遲早有用得上這招的時候，改變主意了就來找我。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
The sky still looks clear, but recently the winds that have been blowing through the land seem to carry with them an air of misfortune.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
天空看起來依然晴朗，但最近吹過這片土地的風，似乎帶著不祥的氣息。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
So...
Danger's coming?
Heh! Chill, gramps~
I got it covered!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
所以...危險快來了？
嘿，放心吧，老爺子~
有我呢！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Ho ho...
Energetic, but
cocky. Kids nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
呵呵...有朝氣，就是太自負。
現在的年輕人啊...
